title: About Marshall Automotive LLC
subtitle: A local shop built on straight answers and solid work.
body_1: Marshall Automotive LLC is a family-owned repair shop right here on Lebanon Pike in Hermitage, Tennessee. Marshall opened the doors with one simple idea: treat every vehicle that rolls in like it belongs to family, and tell people the truth about what it needs.
body_2: That means clear explanations before the work starts, fair pricing, quality parts, and repairs that hold up. If something can wait, we tell you. If something is unsafe, we tell you that too. No pressure, no padded invoices.
body_3: From daily drivers and work trucks to weekend classics, our technicians have the experience and the equipment to diagnose it right the first time — and to get you back on the road quickly.

values.title: Honest Recommendations
values.text: We tell you what your vehicle needs now, what can wait, and what does not need touching at all.

values.title: Quality Workmanship
values.text: Repairs done right the first time, using quality parts and the correct procedures.

values.title: Local & Family-Owned
values.text: We live and work in Hermitage. Our reputation is built one neighbor at a time.

values.title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
values.text: If something is not right, bring it back. We stand behind the work that leaves our bays.
